description: What a client sends back from a screen: a submit when the visitor presses a button, or a back request when the visitor goes back. Riddler.Journey.decode_submit/1 tells the two apart by two keys - a map with no outcome whose back is true is a back request, and every other value is read as a submit - and gives back the submit or the back request for a value this schema validates and findings for any other value. Neither shape refuses a key it does not name, other than the back request's outcome, and the decoder drops a further key. The schema is versioned with the package: it changes only in a release, and that release's changelog names the change.

oneOf.description: What a client sends when the visitor presses a button: the key of the screen it was shown, the outcome of the button pressed and what the visitor entered on that screen. A map carrying outcome is a submit whatever else it carries, back included, and the decoder drops back as a key beside the three.

outcome.description: The outcome of the button the visitor pressed.

responses.description: What the visitor entered on that screen, keyed by question key; an empty object for a screen with no question. What each response has to satisfy is the screen's, checked by Riddler.Screens.validate_screen/3,4, not by this schema.

screen.description: The key of the screen the client was shown.

oneOf.title: Submit

oneOf.description: What a client sends when the visitor goes back from a screen presented with back true: the key of the screen it was shown and back, true, with no outcome, since going back presses no button. A responses sent beside them is dropped by the decoder, so what the visitor entered on the screen left never reaches the root.

back.description: Always true: a back that is anything else is not a back request.

screen.description: The key of the screen the client was shown.

oneOf.title: Back request

title: Submit or back request
